277: static block constant_fold(block a, block b, int op) {
278:   if (!block_is_single(a) || !block_is_const(a) ||
279:       !block_is_single(b) || !block_is_const(b))
280:     return gen_noop();
281:   if (op == '+') {
282:     if (block_const_kind(a) == JV_KIND_NULL) {
283:       block_free(a);
284:       return b;
285:     }
286:     if (block_const_kind(b) == JV_KIND_NULL) {
287:       block_free(b);
288:       return a;
289:     }
290:   }
291:   if (block_const_kind(a) != block_const_kind(b))
292:     return gen_noop();
293: 
294:   jv res = jv_invalid();
295: 
296:   if (block_const_kind(a) == JV_KIND_NUMBER) {
297:     jv jv_a = block_const(a);
298:     jv jv_b = block_const(b);
299: 
300:     double na = jv_number_value(jv_a);
301:     double nb = jv_number_value(jv_b);
302: 
303:     int cmp = jv_cmp(jv_a, jv_b);
304: 
305:     switch (op) {
306:     case '+': res = jv_number(na + nb); break;
307:     case '-': res = jv_number(na - nb); break;
308:     case '*': res = jv_number(na * nb); break;
309:     case '/': res = jv_number(na / nb); break;
310:     case EQ:  res = (cmp == 0 ? jv_true() : jv_false()); break;
311:     case NEQ: res = (cmp != 0 ? jv_true() : jv_false()); break;
312:     case '<': res = (cmp < 0 ? jv_true() : jv_false()); break;
313:     case '>': res = (cmp > 0 ? jv_true() : jv_false()); break;
314:     case LESSEQ: res = (cmp <= 0 ? jv_true() : jv_false()); break;
315:     case GREATEREQ: res = (cmp >= 0 ? jv_true() : jv_false()); break;
316:     default: break;
317:     }
318:   } else if (op == '+' && block_const_kind(a) == JV_KIND_STRING) {
319:     res = jv_string_concat(block_const(a),  block_const(b));
320:   } else {
321:     return gen_noop();
322:   }
323: 
324:   if (jv_get_kind(res) == JV_KIND_INVALID)
325:     return gen_noop();
326: 
327:   block_free(a);
328:   block_free(b);
329:   return gen_const(res);
330: }
